notes.title: Patch 4
notes.content: [h1]CHANGES[/h1][h3]Cages[/h3][list][*][p]Remembered as built when a level is Continued after a defeat, when applicable.[/p][/*][*][p]Spooky is now stunned upon tripping them.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Digging[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced digging time by 16%. Now it lines up intuitively with the final particle. Pickaxe timing remains unchanged.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Figurines[/h3][list][*][p]Upon purchasing, a new one is guaranteed to roll after a maximum of four consecutive duplicates.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels[/h3][list][*][p]Removed a dirt tile allowing the Spooky on the left side of the level [i][u]So Below[/u][/i] to access your spawn too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored more alpha assets for the level [i][u]Those Were the Days[/u][/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]Lives[/h3][list][*][p]No longer destroy your treats when all are used, nor automatically replenish to three.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon losing all lives, the Continue option is now selectable at the cost of 60 treats, the cost of an individual Life Token in the shop.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Pocket Item[/h3][list][*][p]Now retained for a grace period of 5 seconds after using it. If the choice to Restart manually or Continue when a defeat occurs is taken, the retained Pocket Item will carry over. Retained items will be marked with an orange shadow & cannot be taken back out of the level.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Maps now display the info for the level you're standing by without requiring movement first.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]BUG FIXES[/h1][h3]Digging[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced or eliminated the possibility of digging holes beneath your feet.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Decoy[/h3][list][*][p]Now attracts Molemen & Mecha Bees properly.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Inverter[/h3][list][*][p]The possibility of falling through the last used set of Bars after inversion has been mitigated, most observable on the level [i][u]Leaky Pipes.[/u][/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]Tools[/h3][list][*][p]Life Tokens acquired via digging up treasure or defeating enemies now plays the text popup at the proper location.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content: [p][i]Patch has arrived, ya old coots ![/i][/p][p][/p][h1]BUG FIXES[/h1][h3]Achievements[/h3][list][*][p][i][u]Bring That Ladder Back This Instant![/u][/i] is now more reliably triggered. There were some unintuitive conditions attached previously.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Characters[/h3][list][*][p]Mean Boggies now correctly play falling animation after being spawned by a Spawner.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels[/h3][list][*][p]Some secret levels would not appear unless their prerequisite level was completed at least once [i]after[/i] discovering the secret.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Treats[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that could multiply the amount of held treats to the maximum.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Pocket Item slot no longer reappears empty after purchasing a Life Token or Life Token Pair if there wasn't already a Pocket Item held.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 2 1/2
notes.content: [p][i]Hotfix for two bugs introduced in last patch[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]BUG FIXES[/h1][h3]Characters[/h3][list][*][p]Boss wasn't playing defeated animation consistently[/p][/*][/list][h3]Tools[/h3][list][*][p]Expiration sound started to loop indefinitely after first usage every fifteen seconds[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content: [p][i]Welcome, welcome to Patch 2, my dear geezers[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]CHANGES[/h1][h3]Characters[/h3][list][*][p]Jumping Boggies now wait for the player to move first before jumping, consistent with other AI behavior.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Spawners[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced initial delays to 75% of existing values (the addition of the particle telegraphing before each spawn made them easier to counter by adding an additional flat delay).[/p][/*][*][p]Now wait for the player to move first before spawning, consistent with other AI behavior.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Improved the HUD Pocket Item animations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]BUG FIXES[/h1][h3]Characters[/h3][list][*][p]Enemies no longer revert to idle animation after getting trapped in a hole when coming from Spawners or Trampolines.[/p][/*][*][p]Mean Boggies no longer have a chance to get shot into the sky after getting hit by Crowbar or Minecart on a level featuring a moving camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Mean Boggies no longer revert to idle animation after getting hit by Crowbar or Minecart.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Tools[/h3][list][*][p]No longer stack expiration sounds when used or replaced.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels[/h3][list][*][p]The Life Token now spawns correctly on the level [i][u]Butterfingers[/u][/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Removed erroneous secret from the level [i][u]Your Worst Nightmare[/u][/i].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Spawners[/h3][list][*][p]No longer have a chance to spawn an extra enemy past the onscreen cap.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Challenge fail notification will no longer erroneously trigger after the player has already reached the exit door & completed the challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]After purchasing Life Tokens from Pedro's Shop, once the icon plays its animation, your Pocket Item visual returns immediately. It is intended behavior that Life Token purchases do not overwrite held Pocket Items.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content: [p][i]Greetings, elderly![/i][/p][p][i]I bring with me a nice warm patch[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]CHANGES[/h1][h3]Controllers[/h3][list][*][p]Added an override setting for preferred controller icons in the Options menu. Refreshed automatically upon a controller change or relaunch of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The default Steam Input configuration for generic XInput controllers is now tailored to generic gamepads instead of solely Wii remotes. [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3505046964"]The Wii remote configuration is still available as an alternative.[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Accordingly, generic XInput controllers now default to Xbox icons instead of Wii remote icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Joy Con (Pair) icons.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]BUG FIXES[/h1][h3]Controllers[/h3][list][*][p]Steam Deck can now change controller icons back to its respective set while there are other controllers connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Unrecognized controllers should now default to Xbox icons.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Dig Prompt Tutorials[/h3][list][*][p]The dig prompt tutorials in the levels [u][i]Trusty Shovel[/i][/u] & [u][i]Today Is a New Day[/i][/u] will no longer lock players in an unintended direction.[/p][/*][/list]
